about.title: About
about.heading: About Kerala Web Watch
about.intro: Kerala Web Watch is an independent, open-source civic project. It is not an official Government of Kerala service and is not affiliated with any department it audits. It exists so a citizen can check, in plain language, whether a government website works right now, and so a webmaster can see exactly what to fix.
about.contactBody: Source and issue tracker: github.com/hashin/kerala-web-watch. A public contact email is not yet set — until then, please use a GitHub issue.
about.contributeBody: Found a site we're missing, or a wrong entry? Open an issue or a pull request against the registry.
about.privacyBody: No cookies, no analytics, no third-party requests of any kind on this site. Fonts are self-hosted.
about.licenceBody: Code is MIT-licensed; the registry and audit data are CC-BY-4.0.
